answer: Physical Beacon Co-Location Proof. Each identity must periodically emit a radio beacon from a hardware module bound to a fixed location, and neighbors co-sign the received signal report. A witness signs only if the beacon's arrival direction and timing match the claimed site; a plume of coordinated fakes cannot share one physical coordinate. Spoofing demands separate powered hardware per identity across real sites, a dune of capital and maintenance no single operator can fake alone. Independent auditors sample the marble of propagation traces for forgery.
